problems.title: The local-system dual has the wrong shift for Lemma 3.27

source.claim: Theorem 3.26, displayed G on p.38, invoking Lemma 3.27

problems.operative_hypotheses: M=S1, its zero section L, finite field k, product untwisted generating family built from admissible D; s1=2/3, F=D(w)-D(w'), threshold -8/3, A>4, negative index d=0.
problems.decisive_evidence: The band has one index-zero fiber critical point (1,-1), value -4 and Hessian diag(6,6). Thus H=Rpi_*k_band=k_M. Printed RHom(H,k_M[dim M+d])=k_M[1], with RΓ nonzero in degrees -1,0, not degrees 0,1 of RΓk_M. Lemma 3.27 cannot be applied as written.
problems.counterevidence: The zero section already has tube generation and satisfies the geometric conclusions; it is a counterexample to the printed derived normalization, not to the main theorem. The delta-action sign correction is explicitly granted.
problems.dependency: The erroneous normalization supplies the fiber homology for Proposition 3.25 and Theorem 3.26, hence Theorem D and the tube lift used for Theorems A/E.

repair.status: Verified within the stated controlled-Morse/Thom inputs
repair.description: Use H[d] directly. For each finite field pass to a finite cover orienting the base and negative bundle and killing finitely many finite monodromy groups. Thom plus L~M yields RΓ(H[d])~RΓk_M. Lemma 3.27 then gives H[d]=k_M; finite-generation and tensor-product lemmas yield integral rank-one fiber homology.
repair.boundary: Imported Floer projection equivalence, controlled sublevels and sheaf foundations are not re-proved in full.

problems.title: The reordering cylinder has incompatible dimensions

source.claim: Lemma 3.7 final cylinder, used by Theorem 3.9

problems.operative_hypotheses: Point base, three identical charts, n=(0,1,1), q12=q13=u², q23=unit, f1=D, f2=f3=D⊕_b u².
problems.decisive_evidence: For adjacent swap i=1 the prescribed m=2 gives n'=(2,1,3). In the cylinder order 1<2<2'<1'<3<3' the dimensions are 0,1,1,2,1,3. Edge 1'→3 requires dimension -1. Also q33'=0 has dimension zero although the required difference is two.
problems.counterevidence: The preceding formulas for reordered functions and their cocycles do pass; they still generate the same immersion. The nearby-Lagrangian existence argument can use these functions and recover the twisting class by projection equivalence and Gauss factorization.
problems.dependency: Auxiliary equivalence/class-preservation argument; an unavoidable core obstruction was not established.

repair.status: Partial; reordered functions checked, general replacement cylinder not supplied
repair.boundary: No claim that the full generic equivalence assertion is false.

problems.title: The translation construction is not a strict Q-cocycle

source.claim: Lemma 2.23, doubled cover proof on p.17

problems.operative_hypotheses: Normalized nondegenerate ordered quadratic forms with strict direct-sum cocycles, q in Q1, unchanged old forms and cross rule q_i'j''=q⊕q_ij.
problems.decisive_evidence: Triple i'<j'<j'' requires q_ij⊕q=q⊕q_ij. For q=+u² and q_ij=-u² the matrices diag(-1,1) and diag(1,-1) differ. All-first/all-second ordering also asks for old q_ij with j<i. For the universal identity representative, commuting A with the one-dimensional ε block forces A=εI; this factors through the contractible definite-form submonoid and cannot represent the noncontractible identity.
problems.counterevidence: The conclusion is not disproved. Core factorization only needs the inclusion map, not its equivalence. Freely selected auxiliary dimensions can be even; the explicit shift in Theorem 3.9 is 2m. Even translations in the full stabilized model follow from left h action and Theorem 2.21, bypassing the bad full +1 argument.
problems.dependency: The general translation/inclusion proof is damaged; no indispensable use of the stronger full +1 assertion in the main theorem was established.

repair.status: Full general coherent replacement outstanding; actual main uses and even-shift bypass checked
repair.boundary: Homotopy commutativity by itself is not a complete strict-cocycle repair.

problems.title: The refinement cylinder order can contain a cycle
problems.operative_hypotheses: X={0,1}; I:a<b, Ua={0},Ub={1}; J:c<d,Vc={1},Vd={0}; σ(c)=b,σ(d)=a. Refinement is locally monotone as required.
problems.decisive_evidence: Printed mixed comparison gives a<c and d<a, while J gives c<d: a<c<d<a. It is not a partial order.
problems.counterevidence: All actual local MV data remain valid; no local cocycle or resulting homotopy class changes under the repair.

repair.description: Retain in J only comparisons supported by nonempty overlaps, take their transitive closure, then form and close the mixed relation. σ is now globally monotone. Every crossing cycle would include a strict increase in I, hence cannot occur. Local orders, nonempty MV simplices, endpoint maps and cocycles remain identical.
repair.boundary: Canonical identification of covers with identical local orders should be made explicit.

problems.dependency: Global indexing description in an auxiliary refinement argument; unchanged local scientific data bound its impact.

problems.title: The unrestricted lifting statement needs proper critical data

source.claim: Theorem 3.6 read with Definition 2.1 and Remark 2.2

problems.operative_hypotheses: M is a point, f^t(v)=sin v, L={π/2+kπ:k∈Z}; the critical derivative is transverse and the resulting immersion into J1(point)=R has values ±1.
problems.decisive_evidence: A compactly supported contact isotopy translates neighborhoods of both values by 1/4. Any finite stabilization plus a compactly supported correction leaves infinitely many critical points (π/2+kπ,0), for large |k|, at the unchanged values ±1. These cannot generate the target values 5/4,-3/4.
problems.counterevidence: Section 3's closed-L motivation and the actual linear-at-infinity application exclude this nonproper example. That application has proper critical data over the compact isotopy support.

repair.status: Actual compact application checked; general formulation needs properness and parametric support hypotheses
repair.boundary: No refutation of Theorem D or the compact generating-family lifting theorem.

problems.dependency: Local statement-scope defect in a broadly worded auxiliary theorem.

Use the actual local singular-set cover as a refinement; no independent core counterexample inferred from an overstrong equality with full inverse-image charts.
Free BO groups use rational injectivity, Z/2 groups use J detection, and π0 is treated by the separate integer index. No defect found in that bounded inference.

Major is supported for the printed core derivation; no geometric main-theorem counterexample is claimed.
